"You are an implementation subagent for the Twyne native GPUI port in /home/diogenes/Projects/twyne. The user explicitly requested parallel delegation of all previously unstarted port areas, including Gemini3.8 Flash, Crush and OpenCode. The goal is the existing Electrobun-hosted Twyne app rendered with GPUI and original styling/assets, with offline writing first. A working native editor/local storage/Typst/House/local panels already exist. Your slice must produce concrete reusable implementation plus source-backed fixtures, not only a plan.

You are NOT alone in the codebase. Preserve every other agent's edits and all pre-existing dirty work. Ownership below is EXCLUSIVE and NEW files only. Do not edit Source, existing native files, .github workflows, manifests/lockfiles, exports, assets, central app.rs/main.rs/lib.rs, or existing tests. If integration/dependencies are needed, write an UNAPPLIED patch and exact contract inside your owned fixture directory. Parent owns integration and all Cargo/Devenv execution. Do not run Cargo, Devenv, installs, dependency fetches, deployments, commits, or publishing. Read AGENTS.md; prefix EVERY shell command with rtk (use rtk proxy for raw output). Before reading any Convex code, read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md; Convex is read-only for you. Secrets and real accounts are off limits: do not read .env/auth stores/tokens or call real providers/remote mutation APIs. Do not send messages to people. No user display/browser/microphone/audio capture. Use only new owned loopback fixtures and synthetic assets; no downloads of models/weights. Existing cached libraries, standalone rustc and Bun source-backed tests are allowed. Do not spawn additional agents.

Read desktop/gpui/PORT_PLAN.md and the relevant Source implementations before defining your contract. Keep Source-authoritative behaviors and permission/failure states. No fake success, silent fallback, changed authorship, or tests that merely mirror the implementation. New APIs should preserve owner/request/revision identity, bounded queues/bytes/timeouts and cancellation where relevant. Match existing Rust edition2024 and serde/workspace conventions. Keep any whole-document/provider work away from keystrokes. If real-device/provider proof cannot run within this slice, implement the adapter and record that exact proof boundary. Stop after your bounded deliverable; parent integrates. Report files, concrete APIs, checks actually run, unapplied integration requirements and remaining proof in your owned HANDOFF.md.

Bounded smaller responsibility: macOS/Windows/accessibility/OS integration acceptance and a reusable independent verifier. Ownership ONLY NEW desktop/gpui/fixtures/platform-acceptance/**. Read existing native app/key bindings/menus/file dialogs/platform APIs and cross-platform workflow (read-only); distinguish implemented APIs from actual device proof. Produce a source-backed matrix for IME/composition, rich clipboard, open/import/save/file associations/deep links, window close/save recovery and accessibility roles/focus/announcements, with exact current defects or missing native wiring. Add an executable static contract verifier for objective high-value issues (wrong target helper names, missing permission/bundle metadata or missing keyboard aliases), avoiding tests that only assert current implementation. Test the verifier on intentional broken/valid owned fixtures. No existing native/platform/packaging files may be edited; report minimal coordinator patches. No user desktop or account operations. Packaging implementation is another lane; do not duplicate its scripts."
